SELECT s.store_id AS store_id, s.region AS region, f.channel_code AS chan, count(*) AS n_lines, sum(f.net_amount) AS net_amt, sum(f.standard_cost) AS std_cost, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS staff_n, min(f.sale_date) AS first_d, max(f.sale_date) AS last_d, count(DISTINCT f.sale_date) AS n_days
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' AND (s.region='South' OR s.store_id>=900 OR s.store_id=114)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT f.staff_purchase_flag AS staff, count(*) AS n_lines, sum(f.net_amount) AS net_amt, sum(f.standard_cost) AS std_cost,
 round(100*(sum(f.net_amount)-sum(f.standard_cost))/sum(f.net_amount),1) AS margin_pct,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.standard_cost - f.quantity*p.standard_unit_cost) > 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cost_mismatch,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate)) > 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vat_mismatch,
 sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date NOT BETWEEN p.valid_from AND p.valid_to THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prod_ver_off
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' AND s.region='South'
GROUP BY ALL

WITH q AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year AS fy, d.fiscal_quarter AS fq, min(d.calendar_date) AS qs, max(d.calendar_date) AS qe
  FROM dim_date d WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_quarter=4 GROUP BY 1,2
),
sales AS (
  SELECT p.sku AS sku, f.net_amount AS rev, f.standard_cost AS cogs, f.quantity AS units
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN q ON f.sale_date BETWEEN q.qs AND q.qe
  WHERE s.region='South' AND s.store_id < 900 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
),
rets AS (
  SELECT p.sku AS sku, -r.refund_net AS rev, -r.standard_cost_returned AS cogs, -r.quantity_returned AS units
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  JOIN q ON r.return_date BETWEEN q.qs AND q.qe
  WHERE s.region='South' AND s.store_id < 900 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
),
u AS (SELECT * FROM sales UNION ALL SELECT * FROM rets),
cur AS (SELECT sku, product_name, category, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY sku ORDER BY valid_from DESC) AS rn FROM dim_product)
SELECT (SELECT fy FROM q) AS fiscal_year, (SELECT fq FROM q) AS fiscal_quarter, u.sku AS sku, c.product_name AS product_name, c.category AS category,
  sum(u.units) AS units_net, round(sum(u.rev),2) AS net_sales, round(sum(u.cogs),2) AS std_cost, round(sum(u.rev)-sum(u.cogs),2) AS gross_margin,
  round(100*(sum(u.rev)-sum(u.cogs))/sum(u.rev),1) AS margin_pct
FROM u JOIN cur c ON c.sku=u.sku AND c.rn=1
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY gross_margin DESC LIMIT 14

WITH cs AS (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND region='South'),
u AS (
  SELECT p.sku AS sku, f.net_amount - f.standard_cost AS gm FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' AND s.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM cs) AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.sku, -(r.refund_net - r.standard_cost_returned) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' AND s.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM cs) AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
)
SELECT sku, round(sum(gm),2) AS gm_current_south FROM u GROUP BY sku ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 12
